record.title: Conjecture on simple tops of Young modules and projective injective polynomial modules
record.statement: For every partition $\lambda$ of $r$, $\operatorname{Top}(Y_\lambda)$ is simple if and only if there exists an integer $n\ge l(\lambda)$ such that $I_n(\lambda)$ is projective.

record.title: Brauer Height Zero Conjecture for 2-blocks of Maximal Defect
record.statement: Let $G$ be a finite group and let $B$ be a $2$-block of $G$ with defect group $P\in\operatorname{Syl}_2(G)$. Then $\chi(1)$ is odd for all $\chi\in\operatorname{Irr}(B)$ if and only if $P$ is abelian.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/17](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3400), page 33. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Recognition criterion for Miller spaces
record.statement: For a space $X$, the following are equivalent: (1) $X$ is a Miller space, meaning that $\operatorname{map}_*(X,K)\simeq *$ for every finite nilpotent CW complex $K$; (2) $\operatorname{map}_*(X,S^n)\simeq *$ for all sufficiently large $n$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3469), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Shokurov’s ACC conjecture for log canonical thresholds
record.statement: For every fixed dimension, the set of all log canonical thresholds of proper ideal sheaves on log canonical varieties over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero satisfies the ascending chain condition; equivalently, it contains no infinite strictly increasing sequence.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3471), page 5. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Kähler fibres and the Fujiki class of the limit fibre
record.statement: Let \(\pi:X\to\Delta\) be a complex analytic family of compact complex manifolds, where \(\Delta\) is a ball about the origin and \(X_t:=\pi^{-1}(t)\). Suppose that \(X_t\) is Kähler for every \(t\in\Delta^\star:=\Delta\setminus\{0\}\). Must the limit fibre \(X_0\) be a Fujiki class \(C\) manifold, i.e. admit a proper holomorphic bimeromorphic map from a compact Kähler manifold?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3471), page 12. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Lower bound for Seshadri constants on minimal surfaces
record.statement:
Let $S$ be a minimal surface, $L$ an ample line bundle on $S$, and $x\in S$ an arbitrary point. Then
\[
\varepsilon(S,L;x)\ge \frac{1}{2+\sqrt[4]{\lvert K_S^2\rvert}}.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3471), page 24. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Equality in the Green–Lazarsfeld index of Veronese algebras
record.statement:
Let $S=K[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ be a polynomial ring over a field $K$ of characteristic $0$, with $n\ge 3$, and let $S^{(c)}=\bigoplus_{i\ge 0}S_{ic}$ be its $c$-th Veronese subring, where $c>2$. Is
\[
\operatorname{index}\bigl(S^{(c)}\bigr)=3c-3
\]
for every $n\ge 3$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/22](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3472), page 47. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Nagata conjecture for general points in the complex projective plane
record.statement:
Let $s_1,\ldots,s_r$ be general closed points in $\mathbb{P}^2_{\mathbb{C}}$. If $r\ge 10$ and $d/m\le\sqrt{r}$, then
\[
\bigl[I_{s_1}^{m}\cap\cdots\cap I_{s_r}^{m}\bigr]_d=0.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/22](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3472), page 50. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Algorithmic solution of random k-SAT beyond the $2^k/k$ density scale
record.statement: Let $\Phi$ be a random $k$-SAT formula on variables $V=\{x_1,\ldots,x_n\}$, formed by choosing $m$ clauses uniformly and independently from all possible $k$-clauses. Is there an efficient, in particular polynomial-time, algorithm that finds a satisfying assignment with high probability for random formulas at densities $m/n$ up to $2^k\omega(k)/k$, for any function $\omega(k)\to\infty$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/23](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3473), page 12. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Critical threshold for two-neighbour bootstrap percolation on the two-dimensional grid
record.statement:
There exist constants $C>c>0$ such that
\[
\frac{\pi^2}{18\log n}-\frac{C}{(\log n)^{3/2}}
\le p_c([n]^2,2)\le
\frac{\pi^2}{18\log n}-\frac{c}{(\log n)^{3/2}}.
\]

record.title: Improve the upper bound for zero-temperature Glauber dynamics on \(\mathbb Z^2\)
record.statement: The report records the best-known bounds for the critical probability of zero-temperature Glauber dynamics on \(\mathbb Z^2\): $$\frac12\le p_c(\mathbb Z^2)<1-\frac{1}{10^{10}}.$$ Improve the upper bound.

record.title: Off-diagonal 3-uniform hypergraph Ramsey lower bound
record.statement:
There is a constant $c>0$ such that

$$\log r_3(s,n)\ge c\,sn\log\left(\frac{n}{s}+1\right)$$

for all $4\le s\le n$.

record.title: Lane–Emden conjecture in four space dimensions
record.statement:
For every $p,q>0$, the elliptic system
\[
\begin{cases}
-\Delta u=v^p & \text{in }\mathbb{R}^{4},\\
-\Delta v=u^q & \text{in }\mathbb{R}^{4}
\end{cases}
\]
has no positive classical solution if and only if
\[
\frac{1}{p+1}+\frac{1}{q+1}>\frac12.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/26](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3476), page 43. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Multiplicity of solutions for a symmetric nonlinear Schrödinger system
record.statement: Let $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^N$ be a smooth domain with $N\le 3$. For the Dirichlet system $-\Delta u+u=u^3+\beta v^2u$, $-\Delta v+v=v^3+\beta u^2v$ in $\Omega$, with $u,v>0$ in $\Omega$ and $u=v=0$ on $\partial\Omega$, for every positive integer $k$ there exists $\beta_k>-1$ such that, whenever $\beta<\beta_k$, the system has at least $k$ pairs of solutions $(u,v)$ and $(v,u)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/26](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3476), page 48. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rosenberg’s conjecture on homotopy invariance of negative algebraic K-theory
record.statement: For every integer $n\le 0$, the assignment $X\mapsto K_n(C(X))$, where $X$ ranges over compact Hausdorff spaces and $C(X)$ is the commutative $C^*$-algebra of continuous complex-valued functions on $X$, is homotopy invariant.

record.title: Existence of the Kervaire invariant one element in dimension 126

record.title: Conjecture XT2 for elliptic curves over a number field
record.statement: Let $K$ be a number field. For every elliptic curve $E/K$, the dimension $\\dim_{\\mathbf F_2}X(E/K)[2]$ is even, where $X(E/K)$ denotes the Shafarevich–Tate group.

record.title: Galois–Suslin cohomology agrees with étale cohomology
record.statement:
Let $k$ be a perfect field, let $X$ be separated and of finite type over $k$, let $G_k$ be the absolute Galois group of $k$, and let $A$ be a continuous, finitely generated $m$-torsion $G_k$-module, where $m$ is invertible in $k$. Then, for every $i$, there is an isomorphism
\[
H^i_{\mathrm{GS}}(X,A)\cong H^i_{\mathrm{ét}}(X,A).
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/30](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3480), page 47. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rosenberg’s homotopy-invariance conjecture for negative K-theory
record.statement: For every integer $n<0$, the functor from compact Hausdorff spaces and continuous maps to abelian groups, $$X\longmapsto K_n(C(X)),$$ where $C(X)$ is the algebra of continuous functions $X\to\mathbb C$, is homotopy invariant.

record.title: Motivic slices over a perfect field are motivic-cohomology modules
record.statement: Let $q\in\mathbb{Z}$ and let $E$ be an arbitrary symmetric $T$-spectrum in $\operatorname{Spt}(\mathcal{M}_X)$. If the base scheme $X$ is a perfect field $k$, then the $q$-slice $s_qE$ is equipped with a natural structure of an $HZ$-module in $\operatorname{Spt}(\mathcal{M}_X)$, where $HZ$ is Voevodsky’s motivic Eilenberg–MacLane spectrum.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/31](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3481), page 23. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Minimal average length of cyclically related billiard trajectories
record.statement:
Let $\Pi\subset\mathbb D$ be an ideal hyperbolic polygon with $k$ counterclockwise-enumerated sides, and let $\Pi_0$ be a regular ideal hyperbolic $k$-gon, also equipped with a counterclockwise enumeration. For every $\mathbf a\in S_{\mathrm{per}}(\Pi)$, the conjecture is
\[
L_{\mathrm{av}}(\Pi,\mathbf a)\ge L(\Pi_0,\mathbf a),
\]
with equality if and only if $\Pi$ is also a regular polygon.

record.title: Standardness of the blow-up limit in the higher-order Liouville equation
record.statement:
The function $\eta_0$ obtained as the limit in (5) is a standard solution of (6). Equivalently, there exist $\lambda>0$ and $x_0\in\mathbb{R}^{2m}$ such that
\[
\eta_0(x)=\log\frac{2\lambda}{1+\lambda^2|x-x_0|^2}\quad\text{for all }x\in\mathbb{R}^{2m}.
\]

record.title: Exponential law for metastable exit times in the random-field Curie–Weiss model
record.statement: In the random-field Curie–Weiss model, under the hypothesis of Theorem 1, almost surely with respect to the environment, $$P_\sigma\!\left(\frac{\tau_B}{E^\sigma\tau_B}>t\right)\mathrel{\longrightarrow}e^{-t}\quad\text{as }N\uparrow\infty,$$ for all $\sigma\in A$ and for all $t\in\mathbb{R}_+$.

record.statement: Consider a random walk in a uniformly elliptic i.i.d. random environment in dimensions $d\ge 2$. For every $\gamma\in(0,1)$ and every direction $l\in S^{d-1}$, are $(T)_\gamma\mid l$ and $(T')\mid l$ equivalent?

record.title: Stability of atomic ground-state quantum numbers down to neutral atoms
record.statement: Prove that the theoretical ground-state numbers in Theorem 1—namely the angular-momentum quantum number, spin quantum number, and dimension listed for the isoelectronic sequences with $N=1,\ldots,10$—do not change as $Z$ is decreased from sufficiently large values down to $Z=N$.

record.title: Type and ergodicity of the Connes–Marcolli ${\rm GL}_2$-system action
record.statement: For every $\beta\in(1,2]$, the action of ${\rm GL}_2(\mathbb Q)$ on $\bigl({\rm PGL}_2(\mathbb R)\times {\rm Mat}_2(\mathbb A_f),\,\mu_\infty\times\mu_{\beta,f}\bigr)$ is amenable, ergodic, and of type ${\rm III}_1$. record.title: Ring C*-algebras for rings with zero-divisors
record.statement: Can ring $C^*$-algebras be generalized to arbitrary rings with zero-divisors by replacing the isometries in the definition with partial isometries, in a way that gives a reasonable organization of the support projections of these partial isometries implementing multiplication in the ring?

record.title: Degeneracy of the quasiconvexified increasingly rigid single-slip model for subquadratic hardening
record.statement:
For all $p\in[1,2)$, one has $W^{qc}_{\varepsilon}(F)=0$ for all $F\in N$, where
$$
W_{\varepsilon}(F)=\inf_{\gamma\in\mathbb{R}}\left\{\frac{1}{\varepsilon}\operatorname{dist}^{2}\!\bigl(F(\operatorname{Id}-\gamma s\otimes m),SO(2)\bigr)+|\gamma|^{p}\right\}
$$
and
$$
N=\{F:\det F=1,\ |Fs|\le 1\}.
$$

record.title: Extremal-graph reduction for the Nash mapping
record.statement: If the Nash mapping is bijective for singularities whose minimal good resolution graph is extremal, then it is bijective in general. record.title: Global jet-scheme isomorphism problem
record.statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of arbitrary characteristic. For a morphism $f:X\to Y$ of $k$-schemes, let $f_m:X_m\to Y_m$ be the induced morphism of $m$-jet schemes. If $f_m$ is an isomorphism for every $m\in\mathbb{N}$, is $f$ an isomorphism?

record.title: Igusa’s monodromy conjecture for p-adic zeta functions
record.statement:
Let $f$ be a non-constant polynomial in $n$ variables over $\Q$. For all but finitely many prime numbers $p$, if $s_0$ is a pole of the $p$-adic Igusa zeta function
\[
Z_p(f;s)=\int_{\mathbf Z_p^n}|f(x)|_p^s\,|dx|,
\]
then $\exp(2\pi i s_0)$ is a monodromy eigenvalue of $f:\mathbf C^n\to\mathbf C$ at some point of the hypersurface $\{f=0\}$.

record.title: Shokurov’s ACC conjecture for log canonical thresholds on smooth varieties
record.statement:

\]
of log canonical thresholds on smooth varieties of dimension $n$ satisfies the ascending chain condition; equivalently, it contains no infinite strictly increasing sequence.

record.statement:
Let \(

A(
u)+

record.title: Isometry Conjecture for Complete Embedded Minimal Surfaces
record.statement: **Conjecture 11 (Isometry Conjecture, Choi, Meeks, White).** If $M\in C$, then every intrinsic isometry of $M$ extends to an ambient isometry of $\mathbb{R}^3$. Furthermore, if $M$ is not a helicoid, then it is minimally rigid, in the sense that any isometric minimal immersion of $M$ into $\mathbb{R}^3$ is congruent to $M$.

record.title: Strong chord–arc bound for embedded minimal disks
record.statement:
There exists a constant $C>0$ such that, if $0\in\Sigma$ is an embedded minimal disk and $B_R(0)\subset\Sigma\setminus\partial\Sigma$, then whenever $R/2\ge r_0>0$ and
\[
\sup_{B_{r_0}(0)}|A|^2\ge r_0^{-2},
\]
for every $x\in B_{R/2}(0)$ one has
\[
C\,\operatorname{dist}_{\Sigma}(x,0)\le |x|+r_0.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/45](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4128), page 23. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Independence required to fool bounded-depth AC⁰ circuits
record.statement: How large does $r=r(m,d,\varepsilon)$ have to be in order for every $r$-independent distribution $\mu$ on ${\{0,1\}}^n$ to $\varepsilon$-fool every function $F$ that is computed by a depth-$d$ $AC^0$ circuit of size $\le m$?

record.title: Finite-field Kakeya conjecture
record.statement: Let $\mathbb{F}$ be a finite field of size $q$. A set $K\subseteq\mathbb{F}^n$ is Kakeya if, for every direction $b\in\mathbb{F}^n$, there exists $a\in\mathbb{F}^n$ such that $\{a+t b\mid t\in\mathbb{F}\}\subseteq K$. The conjecture states that there is a constant $C_n$, depending only on $n$, such that $|K|\ge C_n q^n$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/52](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4135), page 21. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Adaptive versus non-adaptive query complexity of graph-property testing
record.statement: For every integer $t>2$, there exists a graph property in the adjacency-matrix model such that, if $q$ denotes the query complexity of general (adaptive) testing of the property and $Q$ denotes the corresponding non-adaptive query complexity, then $Q=\widetilde{\Theta}\!\left(q^{\,2-(2/t)}\right)$, where the tilde allows slack by a polylogarithmic factor.

record.title: Unique determination of convex bodies by non-central sections

record.title: Isotropy constant bound for polytopes with few vertices

record.title: The hyperplane conjecture (slicing problem)

record.title: Mahler’s conjecture for origin-symmetric convex bodies
record.statement:
Let $K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, $n\ge 2$, be a convex origin-symmetric body, and let
\[
K^\circ:=\{\xi\in\mathbb{R}^n: x\cdot\xi\le 1\ \text{for all }x\in K\}
\]
be its polar body. Define
\[
P(K):=\operatorname{vol}_n(K)\operatorname{vol}_n(K^\circ).
\]
Is it always true that
\[
P(K)\ge P(B_\infty^n),
\qquad B_\infty^n:=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^n:|x_i|\le 1,\ 1\le i\le n\}?
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4136), page 63. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Expanding property of boundary points of quasiregular escaping sets
record.statement: For a quasiregular mapping $f:\mathbb{R}^{n}\to\mathbb{R}^{n}$, do points of $\partial I(f)$ possess the expanding property? record.title: Göttsche’s universal polynomial for nodal curves
record.statement:
For every integer $r\ge 0$, there exists a universal polynomial $T_r(x,y,z,t)$ of degree $r$ with the following property: given a smooth projective surface $X$ and a $(5r-1)$-very ample line bundle $L$ on $X$, a general $r$-dimensional sublinear system in $|L|$ contains exactly
$$T_r\bigl(L^2,LK_X,c_1(X)^2,c_2(X)\bigr)$$
$r$-nodal curves.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/02](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4197), page 25. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rationality of the remaining moduli spaces of plane curves
record.statement:
For \(G=SL_3(\mathbb C)\), let \(V(d)=\operatorname{Sym}^d(\mathbb C^3)^\vee\) and \(C(d)=\mathbb P(V(d))/G\), the moduli space of plane curves of degree \(d\) under projectivities. Is \(C(d)\) rational for each
\[
d\in\{6,7,8,11,12,14,15,16,18,20,23,24,26,32,48\}? 
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/02](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4197), page 27. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
